name: muna
description: Muna monorepo — a notch / Dynamic Island productivity hub for Windows

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run lint:styles && pnpm run format:check
scripts.e2e: node scripts/not-implemented.mjs e2e M1-E1 "Playwright shell scenario suite S1–S14 needs the notch shell harness"
scripts.msix:build: node scripts/not-implemented.mjs msix:build M0-E3 --fail "MakeAppx packaging script"
scripts.release:updater: node scripts/not-implemented.mjs release:updater M0-E3 --fail "updater signing and latest.json"
scripts.release:verify: node scripts/not-implemented.mjs release:verify M0-E3 --fail "signtool and updater signature verification"
scripts.sbom: node scripts/not-implemented.mjs sbom M0-E3 --fail "CycloneDX SBOM generation"
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test --run --coverage && pnpm run i18n:check && pnpm run storybook:ci
